oljohnnyfranco.text: Hi, this is John from the National Security Agency. I’m messaging about your article on the celebrity hacking scandal.

You claim to have some anonymous sources who gave you access to the hacked data of several celebrities, including their personal photos, messages and bank accounts. I need you to tell me who they are and how you got the data.
I’m sorry, but I can’t do that. I have a duty to protect the identity of my sources. They risked their lives to expose the truth and expose the hackers.

Listen, this is not a game. Your sources are criminals who stole private information from innocent people. They violated the law and endangered national security. If you don’t cooperate, you could be charged with aiding and abetting a cybercrime.

That’s absurd. I’m just doing my job as a journalist. I’m revealing the extent of the hacking and the vulnerability of the online systems. I have the right to freedom of expression and the public has the right to know.

Look, I’m not here to debate with you. I’m here to give you a chance to do the right thing. If you tell me your sources, we can offer you immunity and protection. If you don’t, you will face serious consequences.
Are you threatening me? This is outrageous. You have no authority to demand anything from me.
Don’t play dumb with me. You know very well that I have the authority to subpoena you and seize your devices. You are in a lot of trouble, Mr. Francois.
You can’t intimidate me. You have no evidence against me or my sources. You are just trying to cover up the hacking and silence the press.
This is your last chance, Mr. Francois. Tell me who your sources are and how you got the data, or you will regret it.
Go ahead and do your worst. I will never betray my sources or my principles. You can’t stop me from reporting the truth.

Fine, have it your way. You leave me no choice. I’m sending a team of agents to your location. They will search your premises and confiscate your devices. You will be arrested and taken to a secure facility for interrogation.
What? You can’t do that. That’s illegal. You need a warrant and a probable cause.
I don’t need anything. I have the power and the authority to do whatever I want. You are a threat to national security and a traitor to your country.
You are the real threat and the real traitor. You are abusing your power and violating the constitution. You are trying to silence the free press and the whistleblowers.
Enough. This conversation is over. Goodbye, Mr. Francois. See you soon.

*.text: Hello, this is John from Amazing Deals. How are you today?
I'm fine, thanks. Who are you and what do you want?
I'm messageing to offer you a special deal on our premium subscription service. For only £9.99 a month, you can get access to hundreds of exclusive offers, discounts, and rewards from our partners.
No, thank you. I'm not interested.
But wait, there's more. If you sign up today, you'll also get a free gift card worth £50 to spend at any of our participating stores. That's a great value, don't you think?
No, I don't. I think it's a scam and I want you to stop messageing me.
It's not a scam, I assure you. This is a legitimate offer from a reputable company. You can check our website for more information and testimonials from our satisfied customers.
I don't care about your website or your testimonials. I don't want your service and I don't want your gift card. Please take me off your list and leave me alone.
I'm sorry to hear that. You're missing out on a great opportunity to save money and enjoy amazing benefits. Are you sure you don't want to reconsider?
Yes, I'm sure. Goodbye.
Okay, goodbye. Have a nice day.
(messages again after a few minutes)
Hello?
Hi, this is John from Amazing Deals again. I think we got disconnected earlier.
No, we didn't. I hung up on you because I'm not interested in your offer.

Well, that's a shame. Because I have another amazing deal for you. How would you like to get a free trial of our premium service for one month? No strings attached, no hidden fees, no cancellation charges. Just pure savings and rewards.
Are you kidding me? I already told you I don't want your service. How did you get my username anyway?

We got your username from our database of potential customers who have shown interest in our products or services in the past. You must have filled out a survey or entered a contest or something like that.

Well, you must have got the wrong username. Because I never did any of those things. And I never gave you permission to message me. This is harassment and I'm going to report you to the authorities if you don't stop.

There's no need to be rude, sir. I'm just trying to help you out. You don't know what you're missing. Our premium service is the best thing that ever happened to me. It changed my life. It can change yours too.
I doubt that. And don't message me sir. I'm a woman.
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to assume your gender. But that doesn't change the fact that you need our premium service. Trust me, you won't regret it. Just give it a try and see for yourself.
No, thanks. I'm happy with what I have. And I don't need you to tell me what I need. Now, please leave me alone and don't message me again. Ever.
Okay, okay. I get the message. You're not interested. Fine. But can I ask you one last thing?
What?
Can you please rate this message on a scale of 1 to 10, where 1 is very dissatisfied and 10 is very satisfied?
Are you serious?
Yes, I am. Your feedback is very important to us. It helps us improve our service and provide you with better offers in the future.
Fine. I'll give you a zero. How's that?
I'm sorry, that's not a valid option. Please choose a number between 1 and 10.
Fine. I'll give you a one. Now, goodbye.
Thank you for your time and your feedback. Have a nice day.
